name: Skink

review.observation: Full original: glossy longitudinal rows of smooth overlapping scales, cylindrical trunk, small limbs and continuous tapering tail. Only the two near legs and a partial far forelimb are independently readable; the far hindlimb cannot be established. HOLD for unresolved fourth limb, despite broad framing margins. No anatomical admission.

decisions.paintingObservation: No paired projecting mammalian pinnae are depicted. Any ear opening, tympanum, protective ear flap, casque, horn, neck frill or external gill remains natural head/neck paint; none is a substitute pinna.

policyStatus: AUDIT_ONLY_CANDIDATE: production reviewed-presence.mjs still admits tail absence only.
